description: An athlete's watch and platform connections, as the Connections panel shows them: Garmin, Wahoo, Polar, COROS and Intervals.icu — which are connected, when each last synced, which this server can offer at all, and for each one not connected the link the athlete opens to connect it (it is their account to authorise, so the link is theirs to open; Garmin asks for their Garmin login in their portal). Also the upload address for apps like HealthFit.

athlete_id.description: May be omitted when you coach exactly one athlete.

name: list_connections
